Carrier profile

One profile. Every load you can run.

Build a verifiable record of your equipment, lanes, credentials, and completed work. Shippers see the same facts you maintain — no second-guessing, no phone tag.

Anatomy of a profile

Six sections. One source of truth.

Each section answers a question a shipper asks before they book. Fill them in once, and every future load starts further along.

🚚

Equipment

List your trucks and trailers with capacity and details. Shippers post exact equipment needs, so a complete equipment record means better-fit matches.

🗺️

Lanes

Save the lanes you actually run and set lane alerts. New postings on your lanes reach you without living on the load board.

📋

Credentials

Record your USDOT or MC authority and complete carrier verification — authority, insurance, and identity — before booking loads.

📦

Work history

Every load you request, run, and close leaves a dated line item in your history — pickup, delivery, equipment, and the company you worked with.

⭐

Reputation

Reviews are tied to completed work between members — not anonymous drive-by ratings. Your trust record builds from what you actually deliver.

🔒

Privacy

You control what other members see. Your email and phone stay hidden unless you choose to share them, and on-site contact numbers on loads are revealed only after a booking is accepted.

How it builds

From blank profile to bookable carrier.

  • 1 · Create the profile. Sign up with your company or operating name and add your USDOT or MC number.
  • 2 · Add equipment and lanes. One entry per truck. Save the lanes you want matched and set alerts.
  • 3 · Complete carrier verification. Authority, insurance, and identity checks unlock load booking.
  • 4 · Run loads and close them out. Each completed load adds a verifiable line to your work history — and your plan's truck count sets how many you can run at once.

What shippers see

Your company name, equipment, work history, and reviews from completed loads. What they never see without your say-so: your email, your phone, and the contact details on your active work. Trust here is built from records of real activity, not self-reported numbers.

Straight answers

  • Do I have to fill everything in at once? No. Start with equipment and lanes; history and reviews build as you complete work.
  • Can loads be faked to pump up a profile? Load history entries come from actual marketplace activity between verified accounts, and members can report suspicious posts — three independent reports pull a load off the board for review.
  • Who verifies credentials? You submit authority, insurance, and identity details in carrier verification, and every counterparty is expected to independently verify before releasing freight. The platform is a marketplace, not an insurer or guarantor.
  • What does it cost? A monthly subscription based on your fleet size — no commission on your loads. See pricing.
